A High Renaissance oil painting in the style of Raphael, square 1:1, exact composition of Raphael's Transfiguration, not mirrored, not reimagined. Upper half: a radiant figure in shining white robes floats with open arms in a bright golden-white circle of light above a green hilltop, with two bearded elders in robes floating at his left and right, and three figures on the hilltop below shading their eyes from the glow. Lower half, in darker shade: on the left a group of men in red, blue and ochre robes gesture and discuss; on the right a family group, a father gently supporting his young son, with a kneeling woman in pink and blue in the centre foreground pointing toward them. Dramatic light and shadow, rich reds, blues, greens and golds, smooth blended brushwork. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

A High Renaissance oil painting in the style of Raphael, square 1:1, exact composition of Raphael's Sistine Madonna, not mirrored, not reimagined. A young mother in a red dress and a flowing blue-green cloak stands on soft white clouds in the centre, gently holding her baby wrapped in white cloth; both look calmly toward the viewer. On the left, an old bearded man in a golden embroidered cloak kneels and gestures outward, a golden crown-like tiara resting on the ledge beside him. On the right, a young woman in olive and gold robes kneels with lowered eyes. Behind them a glowing golden sky of soft clouds. Green curtains are drawn open at the top corners. At the bottom edge, two small winged children lean on a wooden ledge, resting their chins on their arms and looking up. Warm glowing light, smooth brushwork. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

A French Romantic oil painting in the style of Eugène Delacroix, square 1:1, exact composition of Liberty Leading the People, not mirrored, not reimagined. In the centre, a strong allegorical woman in a long flowing cream-yellow dress and a red cap strides forward and upward over a heap of paving stones and wooden beams, holding a large blue, white and red flag high above her head. To her left, a man in a black top hat and dark coat; behind him workers with caps. To her right, a lively young boy in a beret raising his arms. In the foreground, figures resting on the paving stones, half hidden in shadow and fabric. Behind them, billowing grey-brown smoke and the faint towers of a Paris cathedral. Earthy browns and greys with bright red, white and blue accents, energetic brushwork. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

A Baroque oil painting in the style of Caravaggio, square 1:1, exact composition of The Musicians (Metropolitan Museum), not mirrored, not reimagined. Four young musicians in loose white and warm red-brown classical robes sit close together around sheets of music. In the centre front a youth in white tunes a lute, turned to the left. Behind him at the right, a youth with dark curly hair holds a brass cornett and looks toward the viewer. At the far right, a youth seen from the back reads a music score. At the far left, a youth with small feathered wings, dressed in white, reaches up toward a bunch of grapes. Dark umber background, warm soft light from the left, realistic textures of fabric and instruments. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

An Italian Renaissance tempera painting in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's workshop, square 1:1, exact composition of the Madonna Litta, not mirrored, not reimagined. A young mother shown half-length in profile facing left, in a red dress with a dark blue cloak over one shoulder and a light veil over her golden hair, looks down tenderly at the small child she holds in a white blanket; the child turns toward the viewer, holding a little goldfinch bird. Behind them a dark wall with two arched windows, one each side, opening onto a pale blue mountain landscape and sky. Smooth soft modelling, deep blue and red. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

A Flemish Baroque oil painting in the style of Peter Paul Rubens, square 1:1, exact composition of Perseus and Andromeda (Hermitage), not mirrored, not reimagined. On the left, a young hero in gleaming armour, red cloak and winged helmet steps toward a princess; a winged figure of Victory floats above him holding a laurel wreath, and small winged children flutter around. On the right, the fair-haired princess, wrapped in a long white and pale gold robe, stands beside a dark rock. Behind the hero, a white winged horse is held by small winged children. A round shield lies at the lower left. Stormy sea and sky behind. Warm reds, golds and pearly tones, energetic brushwork. The painted surface must fill the entire square edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, nothing outside the artwork.

A museum photograph of the ancient Hellenistic marble statue group Laocoön (Vatican Museums), square 1:1, exact composition of the original, not mirrored, not reimagined. Weathered white-grey marble: a bearded older man sits in the centre on a stone block, his body twisting, right arm raised high above his head, a draped cloth over his lap, with a long carved sea serpent winding around him; two younger figures stand at his left and right, also wrapped by the serpent's coils. Soft even light, realistic marble texture. The statue is centred and fills the frame against a plain dark grey backdrop only, no pedestal, walls, room or other objects.
